scope: 128 new v0 inputs only; no CORE, old boundary sweep, old MP sweep, QuantLib large sweep or training

new_time_budget.rationale: one characteristic year price-error scale; no fit to previously observed residuals

truncation.rationale: order-four leading Richardson factor derived; full observed increments retained as conservative guard, not a rigorous error bound

uncertainty.tail_and_quadrature: cutoff/N/L/degree uncertainties already included; do not double count a tail scalar
uncertainty.forward_roundoff_limit: diagnostic operation-count allowance plus mandatory 50/80/120-digit checks; elementary-function interval enclosure not claimed

estimators.E1: genuine MP Lewis, pinned reference_v2/high_precision.py algebra and reference_v3 affine cache
estimators.E2: genuine MP independent hyperbolic Riccati COS algebra port from pinned reference/route_b.py; NOT float64 relabeled as MP
estimators.implementation_state: targeted runner and MP COS port must be implemented, tested and source-committed AFTER this freeze and before any blinded pricing
estimators.shared_risk: same affine Heston model; independent inversion/algebra is numerical triangulation, not a model truth proof
estimators.coordinates: parse JSON numeric literals by their canonical decimal strings; S=K*mp.exp(x) at each precision; explicitly override old Integrator.values(S=...) and use exact-MP physical stencils, never default Case.S float
estimators.COS_interval: pin base-tau interval for each case/L across all time and physical-S/v stencils; original cumulant interval is heuristic; N/L refinements required

refinement.phase_span: old span formula abs(x)+.04+abs(r)*tau+abs(rho)*(v+kappa*theta*tau)/max(sigma,.1); input-only group maximum over shared p/base-tau and all declared stencils allowed
refinement.axis_decoupling: at least three levels per axis and two final differences; when varying one axis hold the others fixed
refinement.selection: earliest qualifying common three-step window followed by one finer confirming step; retain all computed failures; no strongest-looking pair selection
refinement.ceiling: UNRESOLVED if no confirmed window by j=16 or any reference axis ceiling

acceptance.alpha_rationale: absolute uncertainty sum; zero must belong to numerical consistency band; no empirical coverage multiplier
acceptance.window: all three consecutive levels satisfy zero_consistency and uncertainty_cap
acceptance.refinement_stability: each last time FD increment <=B_R/4, and ratio last/previous<=1/2 OR both increments <=sum of their two propagated time-price uncertainties
acceptance.contraction_rationale: one-bit reduction guard, weaker than nominal 1/16 fourth-order asymptotics; explicitly new, not calibrated on residual outcomes
acceptance.growth_rationale: first derivative absolute stencil amplification doubles when h halves; absolute cap still applies at every window level
acceptance.confirmation: one additional finer step must yield another qualifying overlapping three-step window
acceptance.components: all c/Delta/nu reference axes, cross-route agreement and physical-FD budgets satisfied; no unresolved amplification or solver flags

classification.RESIDUAL_INCOMPATIBLE: reference and numerical stability criteria pass but abs(R_hat)>u_R_hat
classification.caution: incompatibility is estimator/model-boundary discrepancy, not automatic proof that Heston PDE is wrong

population.primary_population: new blinded128 only; old600 not rescored under new rule
population.Phase1C: YES only after new128 PASS AND existing CORE/finite trace requirements unchanged AND no other training blocker; never launch training

sampling.sampler: SciPy Owen-scrambled Sobol d=5; fixed first1024 candidates; input-only Feller-stratified selection of12+12 blocks

reproducibility.serialization: UTF8 LF; reference_v6/.gitattributes enforces identical Git transport

corruption_policy: any frozen math/coding bug invalidates entire run; newv6.1 freeze and unopened inputs, not threshold patch
